notes:
Mid-market SaaS (billing/subscriptions) exploring Redwood for agent/chat support on billing flows. Primary goal: accelerate support agent workflows that can call Stripe/Zuora and return strongly-typed JSON actions (create_invoice, adjust_sub, provide_payment_link). Evaluating Hosted API first for fast time-to-value; if POC meets latency/cost SLOs will convert to Dedicated for predictable throughput. Key ask: streaming responses with tool-calling hooks + structured output guarantee (schema enforcement).

Customer quotes: 'Need end-to-end tool calls to Stripe without adding latency to our UI flows' ; 'P95 < 700ms for interactive agent acceptable, p99 ~1s target for most flows.'

Security asks: SOC2 attestation, SSO/SAML for console access, KMS for key management, audit logs for tool calls, retention policies and EU data residency for EU customers. Concern about PCI surface when sending payment-related identifiers to Redwood runtime — they'd prefer tokenized references and server-side tool execution via webhook.

Commercial: mid-market ARR profile, expect 75k-200k ARR if Dedicated pricing aligns with committed throughput. Procurement conversation scheduled after security signoff. SE to help with integration plan (sample tool-adapter for Stripe + Zuora).
